models.rationale: Currently serves live citizen pipe leak complaints; fast (30.4ms mean) and stable; misses fine sprays (<4px) but provides safe baseline until shadow validation completes.
Improved accuracy over baseline when evaluated whole-image, but still misses ultra-fine pinholes when downscaled; superseded by Calibrated Patch v2.

models.model_name: Water Calibrated Hierarchical Patch v2 Adapter
models.readiness_verdict: APPROVED FOR ISOLATED SHADOW VALIDATION ONLY
models.rationale: Successfully detects microscopic and thin spray leaks (100% recall); satisfies municipal latency SLA (< 150 ms P95); passes all 12 adapter compatibility tests and fallback scenarios. Ready for non-blocking 14-day shadow testing.

INT8 dynamic quantization verified loadable and achieves 28.5% compression with 0 accuracy degradation; requires further engineering in Phase 9 to fuse INT8 quantization into the Patch v2 sliding window pipeline.
Reliable baseline for high-confidence stormwater blockage complaints; retains primary authority.
Severe false positive rate on dry culverts and normal gutters (35% false alarm rate); blocked until 100 clean, functional normal drain images are ingested per Task 3 expansion manifest.
Excellent plastic detection on street garbage; minority classes (cardboard, glass) lack training data; candidate retraining is prohibited until 150-200 boxes per class are curated.
Serves single-class pothole complaints reliably; multi-class RDD2022 ingestion pipeline is verified and ready, but awaiting the 12.65 GB archive mounting.
